subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd letter-cluster is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)

Option 1) IFM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d00f0d0f4da15521c4c462431b8088c4d56ea338e6bf4589703bcb09e0302a5.png] 

Option 2) OLR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6a9a0d1d4cf2b87e881c0054f97382f3311415e7a569627d2a43e090b89fd8a.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/353d096f57e15e74b59f0f447ec2cb2dfa28c6fb6f4c2aacac0c5f7aa827542d.png]
